rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARavis
Exhibition name: Tower Bridge
rows.Bloom: Red. Strong fragrance. 60 to 80 petals. Average diameter 4.5". Large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Heirloom Old Garden Roses says Tower Bridge™ has old-fashioned, many petaled blooms of rich crimson...
Harkness Roses describe the color of the flowers as "a very traditional deep purple red of the 18th century."
